market_pulse.note: About $69,000, down about 6.2% over 24 hours as of 2:30 AM ET, after an intraday low of $67,922 (CryptoTicker, citing CoinGecko). CoinCodex showed $68,214, down 7.31%, as of 1:00 AM ET.
About $1,942, down about 5.2% over 24 hours as of 2:30 AM ET (CryptoTicker, citing CoinGecko); CoinCodex showed $1,913.62, down 6.41%.

About $2.34 trillion to $2.35 trillion early Friday, down roughly 4% to 7% over 24 hours depending on the measure (CryptoTicker; CoinCodex). CoinGabbar, citing CoinGecko, showed $2.45 trillion, down 3.8%.
About 57% to 59%: 58.50% on CoinCodex as of 1:00 AM ET and 56.6% per CoinGabbar's CoinGecko data as of 11:00 PM ET Thursday.

themes.title: Bitcoin drops to its lowest since August
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell below $69,000 overnight, its lowest level since August, extending Thursday's slide as rising rate-hike odds and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation weighed on risk assets (CoinCentral).

themes.title: More than $1.3 billion in liquidations
themes.summary: About $1.47 billion in leveraged positions were liquidated over 24 hours, about 89% of them longs, hitting more than 175,000 traders; the largest single liquidation was a $31.09 million bitcoin long on Hyperliquid (CoinCentral; CryptoTicker).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.44 billion of net outflows over five sessions through Wednesday, and preliminary Farside data showed another $47.7 million out on Thursday (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Yields and the dollar weigh on crypto
themes.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5% and the U.S. Dollar Index rose above 103 as markets raised the odds of a December Fed rate hike after hotter-than-expected October inflation (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Sentiment hits extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index fell to 20, or extreme fear, from 28 a day earlier, its lowest reading since July 8 (CryptoTicker; CoinGabbar, citing Alternative.me).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin fell about 6% to 7% and Ether about 5% to 6% over 24 hours to early Friday (CryptoTicker; CoinCodex).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: BNB fell about 5.9% to near $634, Solana 2.9% to about $80.50 and XRP 1.3% to about $1.03 over 24 hours; over seven days XRP is down about 14% and Solana about 10% (CryptoTicker).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: The DeFi sector's market cap was about $62.2 billion, down 4.1% over 24 hours, per CoinGecko data cited by CoinGabbar.

categories.name: Derivatives
categories.note: Liquidations totaled about $783 million in bitcoin, $260 million in ether and $54 million in Solana positions over 24 hours (CoinCentral).

watch_list.why: The October PPI report is due Friday and could shape expectations for the Fed's December decision (CoinCentral; CoinGabbar).
Bitcoin is trading just above $68,000, the next downside level Wintermute said it was watching earlier this week (CoinCentral; CoinDesk).
Glassnode data show stablecoin supply fell about $14.2 billion over 30 days, and analysts are watching ETF flows and stablecoins for signs of returning demand (CoinCentral).
